assumptions.statement: The submitted overall-design and key-area polygons are organizer-maintained provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All spatial ratios, prototype positions, and area-derived diagrams are conceptual and must be regenerated when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Official parcels, ownership, regulatory controls, road redlines, utilities, fire, heritage, and engineering constraints are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, demolition, road-redline, utility and approval claims remain unknown; design actions are reversible prototypes or strategy-level recommendations.

assumptions.statement: Repository issue #1029 reports that provisional KEY-003 may be spatially inconsistent with the intended Dazhongsi area.
assumptions.impact: The Dazhongsi role is developed functionally as Market Edge / interoperability district, but no precise station-radius, parcel, intersection, or development-intensity claim is derived from the provisional polygon.

assumptions.statement: EDGECASE JINGZHANG treats long-tail AI failure evidence as opt-in, minimized, de-identified or aggregated by default.
assumptions.impact: No continuous personal tracking, biometric identification, or individual behavior profiling is required by the spatial concept; every live test must define a human fallback and exit condition.

assumptions.statement: T1/T2/T3 are test-exposure tiers and an implementation logic, not statutory land-use zones or promised construction phases.
assumptions.impact: The geometry encodes an auditable design hypothesis that can be moved or resized after professional survey and stakeholder consultation.
